description: Version 3.2, gripper plus handles plus base (builds on 3.1, related: voice-5b59d3bf): Simplify the whole 3.1 setup. It has to be much simpler: fewer parts and features, as little as needed. Nothing should get in the way of the strap-loop slots; keep them completely clear. Shrink the handles part down. Overall, simplify the whole design wherever possible. Keep it parameterized (params.json and the Tune sliders), keep the pieces separable, and keep it driven by the single RobStride RS00 underneath.

results.identified_issue: Design: merged 3.1 arm+gear into driver() with a cup at the handle plate's low end (u slide_u[0]..+cup_len) so the cup stays below the strap slots; gear top = -slide_h/2 - strap_clear. strap_zone() is a box per slot (slot + outer wall + strap_clear margin, both faces); check sweeps 0-30 for intersection with everything except that side's handle. Rejected: keeping the arm with a shorter channel (still an extra part + screws); putting holes through the cup for bolt access (more features). cup_len is capped ~8.5 by flange bolt access (bolt circle r13.5 vs cup reaching r~10 at 8 mm). spigot_d is now motor_boss_d-0.5 and the right base hole is sized on the boss, both to avoid coincident rims that made assembly.stl non-manifold. Interpretation risk: 'shrink the handles part' read as the plate height (and the arm removal); plate length untouched since the hooks fix it. Wrist tab removal assumes mounting via RS00 back face — unverified against B601 wrist.
results.summary: Made 3.2: 7 printed parts instead of 9, nothing near the strap slots, and a 29 mm handle (was 37)
results.detailed_description:
New folder v302_generalist_simple (3.2). I copied 3.1 and took out everything it didn't need.

• Fewer parts: the arms and the hex-boss interface are gone. Each gear now has a short cup on top, and the handle plate's low end drops into it. Gear plus cup is one print, which I'm calling the driver. That leaves 7 printed parts (2 fingers, 2 handles, 2 drivers, 1 base; 3.1 had 9). The 4 interface screws are gone too, so the only screws are the motor's 12.
• Strap slots kept clear: in 3.1 the arm channel and floor ran right under the ventral slot. Now nothing except the handle itself comes within 3 mm of either slot, or of the plate wall beside it, at any swing from 0 to 30°. That 3 mm is a new param, strap_clear. check_geometry.py checks the clearance, and a positive control proves the check would catch a cup that's too long. The red boxes in previews/strap_zones.png show the keep-out zones.
• Smaller handle: the plate is 29 mm across the finger instead of 37 (slot_wall 3→2, slot_gap 24→18). The slots are the same 3.5 × 21 mm and still clear the 12 mm finger by 3 mm on each side. I left the length (67.4 mm) alone because the two finger hooks set it.
• Simpler base: just a disc round the motor (r 29) joined to a smaller disc round the left bushing (r 21, new param bush_r). I removed the wrist tab and its 4 holes, so the RS00's own back face (4× M3 on Ø38) is the wrist mount. The whole stack is 6.5 mm shorter.

Everything is still in params.json (99 params) with Tune sliders. The new cup_len, cup_depth, cup_wall, strap_clear and bush_r have sliders, and bad values show an error message in the preview. The fingers are 1.21, byte-identical. All exports, hole counts and 27 geometry checks pass.

Trade-offs to know about:
• The cup is short (8 mm), because any longer and it covers one of the six motor-flange bolt heads. A check enforces that.
• Nothing has been printed or load-tested.
• There's no wrist adapter. I'm assuming you mount by the motor's back face.

summary: Version 3.2 of the gripper, handles and base needs a much simpler design than 3.1, with fewer parts and shrunken handles. The strap-loop slots must stay completely clear, with params.json, Tune sliders, separable pieces and the single RS00 drive kept.
